planSteps.description: Open the application login page and submit the form with empty required fields.
Verify validation messages appear and the form does not authenticate.
Open the application and inspect its visible navigation and main page.
Verify the page renders without a blank screen or visible runtime error and navigation links are usable.
Navigate to the plant management page using the application's visible navigation.
Verify the page loads, plant-related controls are visible, and there are no visible runtime errors.
Navigate to the task management page using the application's visible navigation.
Verify the task page loads and its available controls render correctly.
Navigate to the AI Plant Doctor using the application's visible navigation.
Verify the doctor page loads and its diagnosis and image-upload controls, if present, are displayed.
Navigate to the AI assistant or chat page using the application's visible navigation.
Verify the chat interface loads and its message input and send control, if present, are usable.
Navigate to the garden planner using the application's visible navigation.
Verify the planner page loads and its available plan-generation controls render.
